description: This file contains client-side JavaScript code for managing purchase list operations, including moving items and ingredients between lists, handling shop section assignments, and updating the UI accordingly.

methods.name: showMessage
methods.description: Displays a message alert of a specified type (e.g., success, danger) temporarily on the page.

methods.name: handleChangeItem
methods.description: Handles the event when an item checkbox is toggled, updating the selection state.

methods.name: handleChangeIngredient
methods.description: Handles the event when an ingredient checkbox is toggled, updating the selection state.

methods.name: mapArticleAmount
methods.description: Creates a mapping of article IDs to their count and name based on selected items.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes event listeners and UI state for purchase list items and ingredients.

methods.name: checkDisabled
methods.description: Enables or disables action buttons based on current selection states.

methods.name: buildPurchaseListOptions
methods.description: Populates the purchase list selection dropdown with available purchase lists.

methods.name: getShopSectionOptions
methods.description: Returns options for shop section selection, including a default '(no shop section)'.

methods.name: initAutocomplete
methods.description: Initializes the autocomplete options for shop section selection.
